title: Validate staging-to-fact publication and dimension lookup
requirement: Return one non-negative integer column named violation_count. A fact records a business event; a dimension supplies its descriptive identity. Staging uses customer_code while the fact stores customer_key. The expected mapping and exact amount/date for each sale_id are independently specified in sy_expected_fact. Observe sy_staging, sy_dimension and sy_fact, then FULL JOIN expected fact to actual fact by sale_id. Count missing/unexpected keys or wrong customer_key/amount/sale_date once per joined row; add duplicate sale_id groups. Purpose: detect a publication that has plausible counts but maps a sale to the wrong customer. RUN actually joins staging to the local dimension. Matching totals alone do not establish correct dimension mapping.
learning_objectives: Validate staging-to-fact publication and dimension lookup
Justify conclusions using independent keys, exact values and observable evidence.
